description: Publishes reversible exact-match aliases and unapplied scored review candidates from governed registry location profiles.
retry: Rerun from the immutable registry pointer; no external requests or partial side effects occur.
checkpoint: Each ZIP2 partition is independently derived in run-scoped staging; no current pointer changes until all partitions pass.
idempotency: Resolved entity IDs and decision IDs are deterministic hashes of rule inputs; releases remain immutable.
cancellation: Stop after the current ZIP2 partition; staged decisions remain unpublished and can be discarded or inspected.
retention_profile: Keep decision releases local-review-only until benchmark and contributing-source policies authorize an export.
